localFindings.old: renders John 1:1c as “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was fully God.”
localFindings.new: renders John 1:1c as “the Word was a god.”

localFindings.old: The grammar requires the third clause of John 1:1 to read either “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was fully God” or “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was fully God.” (qualitative emphasis). It cannot grammatically read “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was fully God.”
localFindings.new: The grammar requires the third clause of John 1:1 to read either “the Word was God” or “the Word was divine” (qualitative emphasis). It cannot grammatically read “the Word was a god.”

localFindings.old: *John 1:1.* “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was fully God.”
localFindings.new: *John 1:1.* “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.”
